title.narrative: Improved comprehensive employment training and policies targeting youth

description.narrative:
Guyana is transitioning towards an environmentally sustainable economy through its Green State Development Strategy (GSDS), focusing on sustainable resource management, economic resilience, and human capital development. The education system is being adapted to meet the demands of a greener economy, with curricula reviews at university and TVET levels to equip the workforce with necessary skills. The GSDS also addresses high drop-out rates among young people and emphasizes strengthening the TVET system to deliver relevant skills.
The strategy involves greening the TVET system to ensure a fair and just transition by equipping individuals with skills for new job opportunities. This includes building TVET capacity to identify skills for new, existing and forthcoming green jobs and design competency standards for green jobs. The initiative aims to provide equal training opportunities for both female and male teachers and trainers, ensuring sustainability through the appropriation of the ILO Greening TVET tool.
